propositions: State-based echo suppression via baseline comparison prevents re-emission of unchanged rich-text bodies across passes by normalizing the local side through the codec before comparing to decoded baseline.

Two distinct comparison paths must be maintained: emit-side compares normalized local against decoded remote via inbound_mapper; baseline-side compares local normalized through RichTextCodec.normalize_outbound against decoded baseline_wire.
WikiTextCodec.normalize_outbound must be redefined to compose decode_inbound(to_wire(t)) rather than remain identity to satisfy the codec law and render wiki on DC updates and creates.
A change-gated 8-byte rich_sha digest stored inline in binding entries bounds looping bodies by triggering exactly one post-push GET at threshold=2, persisting state without per-pass timestamps.
Concurrent both-sides edits of description remain local-wins with additive conflict resolution, raising outbound-field-conflict alerts to track remote divergence.

Cloud and DC send paths must both compose fit_outbound(to_wire(...)) to ensure create and update paths emit the same rendered format; plain-text fallback must degrade gracefully when markdown libraries are absent.
